## What's Changed
* Turn sidebar New Note into a split button with create menu by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/669
* Polish the UI across the app (council 9/9/9/9) by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/670
* Rebuild Connections as an Ink knowledge graph by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/672
* Open settings in a modal dialog (#673)[Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/673
* Truncate long note titles in the Calendar pop-up by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/675
* Remove the Amp provider by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/676
* Move the attachment browser into its own Attachments settings tab (#677)[Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/677
* Fix version history for notes with non-ASCII paths by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/678


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/compare/v0.9.3...v0.9.4
